body:
Decided by Karolis (book, 30 Oct; said again in chat): every morning a bus takes campers home from the beach.
How it works:
- Every day, also days with no bus: the bus waits at the beach 8:00-9:30 and goes to town (same 1.5 game hour wait as now).
- On bus days nothing changes: the normal trip already goes beach -> town in the morning.
- Same fare and free-ride rules as now (20 coins; free with under 20 coins).
- The bus sign and the Town Timetable show it.
- Old saves keep working (the timetable is worked out from the day number; nothing new is saved).
Built in a game update (repo chat), with the full check.
short: Morning bus home from the beach, every day 8:00-9:30
source: chat 2026-10-30: Schedules and economy chat, from decision q-economy-beach-bus-camp
title: Build: a morning bus home from the beach every day
